item.title: Disruption to Advanced Search Editing on the Contacts page [resolved]
item.description:
Engineers have successfully deployed the fix across all systems. Testing confirms that the option to edit advanced searches and segmentations within the Contacts section is now fully restored and operating normally.
This incident is now resolved.
